en.headline: Alibaba chip unit T-Head files confidential application for Hong Kong IPO
en.dek: The company said T-Head submitted a Form A1 application on 11 September after the stock exchange cleared the proposed spin-off, with deal size still undecided.
body: Alibaba Group said on Tuesday that its chip design unit T-Head had confidentially filed for an initial public offering in Hong Kong, advancing plans to spin off the business that supplies data-centre processors.

In a stock-exchange filing, Alibaba said the Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing had cleared it to proceed and that T-Head submitted the confidential application on 11 September. The size and structure of the offering, along with Alibaba’s post-listing stake, have not yet been finalised.

The company said a separate listing would allow investors to value T-Head and its core businesses independently while helping the chipmaker raise capital on its own and strengthen ties with customers, suppliers and partners. The proposed spin-off remains subject to regulatory approvals, and T-Head is expected to remain a subsidiary of Alibaba after completion.

T-Head provides full-stack data-centre chips that enable system-level computing solutions in China. The filing comes amid a broader push by Chinese technology firms to develop and monetise artificial-intelligence and semiconductor assets.

zh.headline: 阿里巴巴晶片單位平頭哥提交香港上市機密申請
zh.dek: 公司表示平頭哥於九月十一日提交A1表格申請，港交所已批准分拆，集資規模仍未敲定。
body: 阿里巴巴集團周二表示，旗下晶片設計單位平頭哥已以機密方式向香港提交首次公開招股申請，推進分拆這家提供數據中心處理器業務的計劃。
阿里巴巴在交易所文件中指出，香港交易及結算所已批准進行有關分拆，平頭哥於九月十一日提交機密申請。招股規模、架構以及阿里巴巴上市後持股比例仍有待確定。
公司表示，獨立上市可讓投資者分別評估平頭哥及其核心業務，同時有助晶片商自行籌集資金，並加強與客戶、供應商及夥伴的聯繫。擬議分拆仍須待監管批准，完成後平頭哥預期仍為阿里巴巴子公司。
平頭哥提供全棧數據中心晶片，支援中國系統級運算方案。是次申請正值中國科技企業積極發展及變現人工智能與半導體資產之際。
